name: honey-blonde-flirty-selfie
image_purpose: Social media collage and beauty-fashion moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create a four-panel photorealistic beauty selfie collage in a warm neutral bathroom or dressing-room setting.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult honey-blonde woman with lighter balayage highlights, long voluminous loose waves, middle part, curtain layers, heart-shaped face, blue-green eyes, glossy nude-pink lips, and soft-glam makeup. She wears a black satin or silk strapless corset-style top with sweetheart bow-front detail and poses playfully across four panels: pout, over-shoulder smile, direct gaze holding a makeup item, and hands framing the face.
prompt.composition_elements: Four equal portrait panels with consistent identity, hair, outfit, and warm neutral background. Include horizontal wood paneling or textured beige tile, a subtle mirror edge or towel bar, and clear separation between poses without added text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffuse front-facing vanity or ring light with catchlights, even face illumination, gentle shadows, warm beige and light-wood palette, playful polished selfie mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone or mirrorless 35-50mm equivalent look, high-resolution multi-panel collage, realistic skin pores and hair strands, subtle grain, restrained saturation, consistent exposure across panels.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A four-panel photorealistic beauty selfie collage of one approved adult honey-blonde woman with lighter balayage highlights, long voluminous loose waves, middle part, curtain layers, heart-shaped face, blue-green eyes, glossy nude-pink lips, and soft-glam makeup. She wears a black satin strapless corset-style top with sweetheart bow-front detail. The four panels show a playful pout, an over-shoulder soft smile, a direct gaze while holding a makeup item, and both hands framing her face in a V shape. Keep consistent identity, hair, outfit, warm neutral bathroom or dressing-room setting, horizontal wood paneling or textured beige tile, subtle mirror edge or towel bar, soft vanity light, realistic skin and fabric texture, and polished social-media collage energy without added text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, inconsistent identity, mismatched panels, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
